title: AI VTuber Viseme Track
description: Compact local viseme timing resolved from a Performance Asset speech.viseme_ref (crates/runtime::cached_playback). Cue viseme names are the closed canonical vocabulary (ADR-0003); the legacy single-letter names used by existing 0.1.0 packs are accepted on read only and are normalized to canonical by the reader. Cross-field rules (non-decreasing at_ms, at_ms <= duration_ms) are enforced by the Rust reader.

deprecated_viseme_alias.description: Read-only legacy spellings: A=aa I=ih U=ou E=ee O=oh N=neutral.
